verdict.rationale: TeamViewer's own marketing describes in-product AI features: Session Insights, an AI note-taker that summarizes cases, spots patterns and highlights insights; an AI troubleshooting assistant that gives device-specific answers and insights in natural language; and Tia, an AI agent that analyzes data from screenshots to error logs and predicts and fixes issues. This covers the core of the story, but the support rests only on pricing and homepage claims. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how insights and suggestions are generated and surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they work as claimed.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: By querying our AI troubleshooting assistant, find faults and fix them fast, using natural language to get real-time, device-specific answers and insights.
Session Insights: Our AI-powered note-taker compiles a summary for each case, spots patterns, highlights insights
Use advanced TeamViewer AI to analyze data, from screenshots to error logs.
Tia, your AI agent, learns from every support session to predict, prevent, and rapidly fix IT issues.
